qualification_observations: Clean v10 qualification includes the exact alpha.31 form-owner fixes and the immutable runtime from all 60 reproduction checks, plus installed collection/editor/VTE/IME, idle/two-broker-CPU-job presentation, browser, offline speech, reboot and failed activation/account-preserving recovery.
The prior v6–v9 distributions remain untouched. Only the redundant guest v9 builder output was removed after fresh SHA-256 equality with the retained host distribution.

The prior v9 qualification exposed an intermittent primary-transfer destination focus failure. An unchanged instrumented repeat and complete v9 fresh-copy run passed; that observation remains open. Its helper identity/password failures and subsequent exact disk/config/EFI restoration are retained in repository history.

An initial compressed v10 conversion ran out of builder space, published no image and cleaned its private temporary directory. The builder now checks a conservative 41 GiB peak-capacity bound before disk/loop creation; all 21 tooling tests pass. The dedicated development test disk was enlarged from 20 to 80 GiB after an exact hash-verified APFS recovery clone; its ext4 filesystem, saved activities, UID and runtime were verified with more than 60 GiB available. The distributed image remains 20 GiB.
The new image uses supported zlib-compressed QCOW2 export. Its unbooted signed artifact remains separate from the verification copy.
